description:
*Industrial Visit to Amul - The Taste of India*
*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli - Fellowship Tour*

*Date: 31st October, 2026 | Time: 10 AM to 1 PM | Venue: Amul Plant*

What a delightful and enriching experience at the *Amul Chocolate and Milk Factory!*

The Rotary members of Skycity Borivli received a very pleasant and warm welcome at the Amul Plant.

The Plant Coordinator explained each and every step of the production facility with great detail - from milk collection to processing and chocolate making.

Truly we realized - *"Amul - Taste of India, and Amul is Anmol."*

An insightful, educational and memorable industrial visit.

Under the dynamic leadership of:
*Rtn. Rajesh Sahu - President*
*Rtn. Sameer Choudhary - Secretary*
*Rtn. Samir Shrimankar - Treasurer*
and Team Skycity

*Learning Together. Growing Together.*

*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli*
